chunks: Does he think that no one sees him?
ai.seo_question: What does the Quran say about God seeing us when we think no one is watching?
ai.summary: In the context of Surah Al-Qari'ah (The Striking Calamity), this verse underscores the inevitability of Divine Reckoning, specifically addressing those who act with impunity under the illusion of being unobserved. Shia exegetes emphasize that this 'hidden observation' serves as a precursor to the detailed accounting of deeds, reinforcing the concept of 'Ilm al-Ghayb' (Knowledge of the Unseen) as a core attribute of Allah that motivates both fear and hope in the believer.
